Limiting alpha-to-zero forces 9:1 among positive diagonal weights. The Hermitian/skew-Hermitian generalized eigenproblem and simultaneous congruence of (P,Q) give an exact sector whose r derivative is strictly negative and whose two extremes are attained. Scalar pressure compression has strictly negative Euclidean determinant for every admissible parameter. Symbolic identities and 120 matrix tests supplement the infinite-family proof.

value.rationale: This is a complete structural characterization for a newly used two-term pressure Schur inverse surrogate, not a slice of arbitrary toy parameters: it supplies the unique stage-only norm ensuring positive real numerical range for every spatial discretization, a sharp noncommuting-SPD angular bound determined by the worst generalized pressure mode, and a rigorous contrast with unconditional Euclidean indefiniteness.
